_ghi_chu_en: EN-ALL GĐ 4 (agent C) — bản phủ tiếng Anh, ban biên tập viết lại (không dịch sát), chờ người bản xứ duyệt. Biến {Chu_tu}/{chu_tu}/{A_tu}/{O_tu}/{chu_de}/{cung}/{sao}/{mang}/{nam}/{thang} do RULES điền bằng chữ tiếng Anh. Chưa phủ: vai_tro_sao, phoi_hop_phai, y_dinh_hoi (từ khoá hỏi đáp tiếng Việt — đợt hỏi đáp).

phi_hoa.giai_thich: Every palace in the chart carries a heavenly stem. From that stem, the four transformations Lu, Quan, Ke and Ji attach to four stars; wherever a star sits, its transformation is read as flying into that palace. The flight paths show which area of life is acting on which.

tu_hoa.giai_thich: When a palace's own stem transforms a star that sits in that same palace, it is called self-transformation. The common reading: the palace's energy rises and fades on its own, so how that area goes depends a lot on how you yourself handle it.

lai_nhan.giai_thich: The palace whose heavenly stem matches your birth-year stem. The flying-star school sees it as the area of life you put the most of yourself into, where many of your stories begin. It is a lens for reflection, not a good or bad label.

xung_chieu.giai_thich: Each palace has an opposite: Life – Travel, Siblings – Friends, Spouse – Career, Children – Property, Wealth – Fortune, Health – Parents. Hua Ji entering a palace is usually read together with its opposite, because the two areas pull on each other.

hop_tham.giai_thich: The other person's birth-year stem sends the four transformations into your chart, to see which areas of your life they tend to touch. This part only describes where the two of you meet; it does not score a match.

dinh_gio.giai_thich: When a birth time sits close to the border between two double-hours, the chart can look completely different. You pick a few years you remember well, read the questions for each candidate hour, and see which hour fits your experience better. The system does not choose the hour for you.

nhip_3_thang.giai_thich: The year's Four Transformations are combined with each month's, to see which area of life comes forward in which month. Each month gets a level of Favourable, Steady or Go carefully, with something to do and a question for reflection. These are monthly themes, not events set in advance.

Lộc.y: Hua Lu in flight: the source area brings ease, chances and joy to the target area. Ease can make you careless, so keep part of it in reserve.

Quyền.y: Hua Quan in flight: the source area pushes initiative, responsibility and a wish to have the final say into the target area. Strength can turn into pushiness, so listen a little more.

Khoa.y: Hua Ke in flight: the source area brings clarity, a good name and gentle ways to untangle things to the target area. It helps reputation and transparency more than gain.

Kỵ.y: Hua Ji in flight: the source area makes you care and worry a lot about the target area, where things tend to slow down or get stuck. Ji points to what needs looking after; it does not mean bad luck.

Mệnh.y: {Chu_tu} often brings chances and helpful people your way; many times someone offers a hand before you even ask.
Mệnh.viec_nen_lam: When {chu_tu} opens a door, say yes early and remember to thank whoever opened it.

Huynh Đệ.y: {Chu_tu} often brings good things to your siblings and close friends, sometimes even a shared savings pot.
Huynh Đệ.viec_nen_lam: When you help siblings with money that came from {chu_tu}, say from the start whether it is a gift or a loan.
Huynh Đệ.can_cu: The flying-star school also links the Siblings Palace with money you hold on to (cash, savings).

Phu Thê.y: {Chu_tu} brings something pleasant into your love life: you meet people on your wavelength more easily, or your partner shares in the good things from this side.
Phu Thê.viec_nen_lam: Tell your partner about the good things coming from {chu_tu}, and invite them to play a part.

Tử Nữ.y: {Chu_tu} often brings joy to your children, your students or the things you make yourself.
Tử Nữ.viec_nen_lam: Set aside part of what {chu_tu} brings for your children or for a personal project you care about.

Tài Bạch.y: {Chu_tu} easily becomes a source of income: your money often comes from that very side.
Tài Bạch.viec_nen_lam: Track the income that comes from {chu_tu} separately in your budget, so you know what it is worth to you.

Tật Ách.y: {Chu_tu} makes you feel well and relaxed, but too much fun can throw off your eating and sleeping times.
Tật Ách.viec_nen_lam: While {chu_tu} is going well, keep a fixed bedtime; do not stay up late just because you are in the mood.

Thiên Di.y: {Chu_tu} goes best when you are out in the world: travelling, changing workplaces and meeting new people all tend to pay off.
Thiên Di.viec_nen_lam: Say yes to trips and meetings linked to {chu_tu}, and introduce yourself first.

Nô Bộc.y: {Chu_tu} helps you meet more people; good friends, colleagues and clients often arrive that way.
Nô Bộc.viec_nen_lam: Keep in touch with the people you meet through {chu_tu}, but do not become the one who always gives first.

Quan Lộc.y: {Chu_tu} opens doors at work: new tasks, new clients or referrals often come from that side.
Quan Lộc.viec_nen_lam: Note down the work that comes through {chu_tu}, then pick one or two pieces to see through rather than taking everything.

Điền Trạch.y: What {chu_tu} brings tends to settle into savings, things that last or the home.
Điền Trạch.viec_nen_lam: Each time {chu_tu} brings in money, move part of it into a home fund or savings the day you receive it.

Phúc Đức.y: {Chu_tu} is a real source of joy for you: once it is taken care of, you feel lighter and sleep better.
Phúc Đức.viec_nen_lam: Keep one fixed slot each week for {chu_tu}, with a set budget of money and time for leisure.

Phụ Mẫu.y: {Chu_tu} makes paperwork, applications and dealings with parents and bosses go more smoothly.
Phụ Mẫu.viec_nen_lam: For anything that needs approval from above, make your move while {chu_tu} is bringing good news.

Mệnh.y: {Chu_tu} puts you in the position of deciding for yourself: you have more say, but you also carry the responsibility.
Mệnh.viec_nen_lam: Before settling anything to do with {chu_tu}, hear one more opinion from someone outside it.

Huynh Đệ.y: {Chu_tu} makes you the one who steps up for your siblings, or brings someone in the family whose word weighs a lot with you.
Huynh Đệ.viec_nen_lam: When you discuss {chu_tu} with siblings, let everyone finish speaking before you decide.

Phu Thê.y: {Chu_tu} brings the question of who decides into your love life; the two of you can end up competing to be right.
Phu Thê.viec_nen_lam: Agree clearly who handles which part of {chu_tu}, and let your partner finish before you suggest anything.

Tử Nữ.y: {Chu_tu} makes you expect a lot from your children, your students or your own small projects.
Tử Nữ.viec_nen_lam: Give your child one part of {chu_tu} to handle and let them choose how to do it.

Tài Bạch.y: {Chu_tu} gives you the drive to earn money; you are good at finding a way when you need to.
Tài Bạch.viec_nen_lam: Set a limit for spending linked to {chu_tu}, so your resourcefulness does not turn into haste.

Tật Ách.y: {Chu_tu} makes you push through: you handle pressure fairly well but rarely let yourself rest.
Tật Ách.viec_nen_lam: When {chu_tu} piles up, break it into stages and keep one fixed hour of rest each day.

Thiên Di.y: {Chu_tu} gives you standing when you are out in the world: you are easily trusted with tasks and respected in new places.
Thiên Di.viec_nen_lam: When {chu_tu} takes you into a new environment, listen first and speak later for the first few weeks.

Nô Bộc.y: {Chu_tu} makes you the one who leads your group of friends or colleagues, or brings people with strong opinions your way.
Nô Bộc.viec_nen_lam: When working as a team around {chu_tu}, agree on everyone's role from the start.

Quan Lộc.y: {Chu_tu} adds push at work: you are easily given roles and authority.
Quan Lộc.viec_nen_lam: When work from {chu_tu} keeps coming in, hand some of it to others instead of doing it all yourself.

Điền Trạch.y: {Chu_tu} hands the decisions about home and property to you; you suit being the one who repairs and organises.
Điền Trạch.viec_nen_lam: Before changing anything big at home because of {chu_tu}, talk it over with the people you live with.

Phúc Đức.y: {Chu_tu} takes up a lot of room in your head; you want everything there to go your way.
Phúc Đức.viec_nen_lam: Each day, give yourself a stretch of time without thinking about {chu_tu}: a walk, cooking, something with your hands.

Phụ Mẫu.y: {Chu_tu} adds weight to paperwork and to dealings with bosses and parents: you have a voice, but things can get tense.
Phụ Mẫu.viec_nen_lam: When something to do with {chu_tu} needs a boss's approval, put it clearly in writing.

Mệnh.y: {Chu_tu} gives you a good name: people understand you correctly and recommend you.
Mệnh.viec_nen_lam: Share what you learned from {chu_tu}; your good name grows from there.

Huynh Đệ.y: {Chu_tu} makes things gentler with siblings and close friends; old misunderstandings are easier to clear up.
Huynh Đệ.viec_nen_lam: While {chu_tu} is going well, invite your siblings for a meal and talk openly about what is still unresolved.

Phu Thê.y: {Chu_tu} keeps your love life gentle; the two of you make up easily.
Phu Thê.viec_nen_lam: If something about {chu_tu} comes up, say it to your partner calmly and plainly; do not let it sit overnight.

Tử Nữ.y: {Chu_tu} helps your children's or students' studies, or the things you make.
Tử Nữ.viec_nen_lam: Tell your child what you learned from {chu_tu}, and praise them for something specific.

Tài Bạch.y: {Chu_tu} keeps money clear, enough and uncomplicated; the gain is in transparency more than in large sums.
Tài Bạch.viec_nen_lam: Keep a separate income-and-spending sheet for {chu_tu} and review it every month.

Tật Ách.y: {Chu_tu} helps you find ways to relax; your daily rhythm is easy to reset when it slips.
Tật Ách.viec_nen_lam: Note down the kinds of rest that helped you recover while dealing with {chu_tu}, and use them again when you are tired.

Thiên Di.y: {Chu_tu} helps you make a good impression when you are out; you tend to meet the right helper at the right time.
Thiên Di.viec_nen_lam: Say yes to courses, conferences or meetings with partners connected to {chu_tu}.

Nô Bộc.y: {Chu_tu} keeps things smooth with friends and colleagues; someone is likely to speak up for you.
Nô Bộc.viec_nen_lam: Keep the small promises you make to people you know through {chu_tu}; that is where your credibility comes from.

Quan Lộc.y: {Chu_tu} brings a good name at work: you are recognised for your skill more than for gain.
Quan Lộc.viec_nen_lam: Put care into presenting and reporting the work linked to {chu_tu}; people need to see it before they recognise it.

Điền Trạch.y: {Chu_tu} keeps home matters and property papers clear and calm.
Điền Trạch.viec_nen_lam: Sort out your property papers and shared household accounts while {chu_tu} is calm.

Phúc Đức.y: {Chu_tu} lightens your mind; you know how to untangle yourself when you feel low.
Phúc Đức.viec_nen_lam: Write a few lines each time {chu_tu} gets you thinking too much; writing it down usually makes it lighter.

Phụ Mẫu.y: {Chu_tu} helps with paperwork, exams and applications: your case is likely to be considered fairly.
Phụ Mẫu.viec_nen_lam: Finish the paperwork still open around {chu_tu}, or ask someone more experienced for feedback.

Mệnh.y: {Chu_tu} is what you care about most; when it does not go smoothly, you feel worn out straight away.
Mệnh.viec_nen_lam: Break {chu_tu} into small tasks, and tell someone close when it gets too much.

Huynh Đệ.y: {Chu_tu} often pulls worry towards your siblings, close friends or your savings.
Huynh Đệ.viec_nen_lam: When {chu_tu} involves family members' money, write down whether it is a gift or a loan.

Phu Thê.y: {Chu_tu} brings snags into your love life: the two of you may expect things without saying them.
Phu Thê.viec_nen_lam: Set a time to talk with your partner about {chu_tu} alone; say how you feel rather than blaming.

Tử Nữ.y: {Chu_tu} makes you worry a lot about your children, your students or your own projects.
Tử Nữ.viec_nen_lam: When {chu_tu} makes you worry about your child, ask what they think before giving advice.

Tài Bạch.y: {Chu_tu} is where money tends to go out faster than you planned.
Tài Bạch.viec_nen_lam: Record everything you spend on {chu_tu}, and do not decide on large amounts the same day.

Tật Ách.y: {Chu_tu} can stretch your daily rhythm: late nights, rushed meals, carrying pressure.
Tật Ách.viec_nen_lam: While {chu_tu} is tense, keep a fixed bedtime; for anything about your body, ask a professional.

Thiên Di.y: {Chu_tu} means going out, travelling or entering new places needs careful preparation; what happens outside can come back and tire you.
Thiên Di.viec_nen_lam: If {chu_tu} takes you far from home, have a backup plan and leave extra time.
Thiên Di.can_cu: Hua Ji in the Travel Palace faces the Life Palace directly (the opposite palace).

Nô Bộc.y: {Chu_tu} turns your worry towards friends and colleagues: misunderstandings, or doing other people's work for them.
Nô Bộc.viec_nen_lam: For shared work on {chu_tu} with friends or colleagues, agree who does what from the very start.

Quan Lộc.y: {Chu_tu} makes work take a lot of effort and move slower than you hoped.
Quan Lộc.viec_nen_lam: While {chu_tu} is messy, keep just one or two main tasks at work and report progress often.

Điền Trạch.y: {Chu_tu} tends to push worry onto your home, property and family matters.
Điền Trạch.viec_nen_lam: Keep a separate reserve for the home, and talk with your family before deciding anything big about {chu_tu}.

Phúc Đức.y: {Chu_tu} keeps coming back into your head at night and can keep you tossing and turning.
Phúc Đức.viec_nen_lam: Set one hour a day for {chu_tu}; outside that hour, write it on paper and leave it there.

Phụ Mẫu.y: {Chu_tu} tends to bring paperwork, contracts and dealings with bosses that need a careful look.
Phụ Mẫu.viec_nen_lam: For papers linked to {chu_tu}, reread every clause and keep a copy.

ky_chieu.Mệnh: When {chu_tu} gets messy, you also tend to blame yourself and feel more tired than usual.
ky_chieu.Huynh Đệ: When {chu_tu} gets messy, things with your siblings tense up too, sometimes turning into money issues in the family.
ky_chieu.Phu Thê: When {chu_tu} gets messy, you may bring the frustration home and the two of you get on each other's nerves.
ky_chieu.Tử Nữ: When {chu_tu} gets messy, you may have less time and less patience for your children.
ky_chieu.Tài Bạch: When {chu_tu} gets messy, money also tends to leak out in unplanned expenses.
ky_chieu.Tật Ách: When {chu_tu} gets messy, you may sleep badly and eat at odd times.
ky_chieu.Thiên Di: When {chu_tu} gets messy, you may hold back from travelling or trying new places.
ky_chieu.Nô Bộc: When {chu_tu} gets messy, you may snap at friends and colleagues over nothing.
ky_chieu.Quan Lộc: When {chu_tu} gets messy, it is hard to focus at work too.
ky_chieu.Điền Trạch: When {chu_tu} gets messy, the mood at home tends to get heavy too.
ky_chieu.Phúc Đức: When {chu_tu} gets messy, it is hard to switch your mind off even when you rest.
ky_chieu.Phụ Mẫu: When {chu_tu} gets messy, paperwork or things with bosses and parents can also hit friction.

Lộc.y: {O_tu}, good things arrive quickly and slip away just as quickly, like water running through.
Lộc.viec_nen_lam: Each time {chu_tu} brings a good result, keep part of it instead of using it all at once.
Lộc.cau_tu_soi: Of the good things lately in {chu_tu}, what have you managed to keep?

Quyền.tieu_de: {A_tu}: quick to decide, quick to change course
Quyền.y: {O_tu}, you tend to decide on your own and change direction very fast, rarely waiting for anyone.
Quyền.viec_nen_lam: Before changing plans about {chu_tu}, wait a day and ask the people involved.
Quyền.cau_tu_soi: The last time you decided alone about {chu_tu}, was there someone who should have been asked first?

Khoa.tieu_de: {A_tu}: you sort it out, but the effort goes unnoticed
Khoa.y: {O_tu}, you usually untangle things yourself, but few people see that effort unless you mention it.
Khoa.viec_nen_lam: Write down what you did well in {chu_tu}, and tell the people involved.
Khoa.cau_tu_soi: Do you often overlook your own effort in {chu_tu}?

Kỵ.tieu_de: {A_tu}: you take it all on yourself
Kỵ.y: {O_tu}, you tend to worry and carry everything yourself, sometimes changing your mind halfway; the snag is usually in how you handle it rather than in other people.
Kỵ.viec_nen_lam: For big decisions about {chu_tu}, write your criteria down first and ask someone outside the situation.
Kỵ.cau_tu_soi: In {chu_tu}, what do you often leave unfinished or change your mind about at the last minute?

mau_duong_bay.nghia: Work takes up a lot of your energy, while looking for a new direction elsewhere may not go smoothly yet.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Before deciding to change jobs, write down what you want to change, try improving things where you are, and research the new place carefully.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: Is it the work itself that tires you, or the way you are doing it?

mau_duong_bay.tieu_de: Friends and partners touch your money
mau_duong_bay.nghia: Your money tends to get tied up with friends, colleagues or partners, and that can weigh on your mind.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: For pooled money, loans or putting your name on something for someone, agree in writing and only use money you can afford to lose.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: Have you said yes to something about money lately just because it was awkward to say no?

mau_duong_bay.tieu_de: Money comes in, then leaves on its own
mau_duong_bay.nghia: You can earn, but money tends to leave through your own quick decisions rather than because of other people.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Move some savings aside as soon as income arrives, and wait a day before large purchases.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: Which recent purchase did you decide quickly and then regret?

mau_duong_bay.nghia: Your money tends to come with contracts, procedures, loans or paperwork obligations that need watching.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Review your current contracts and loans, keep debt at a level you can manage, and ask a professional when a clause is unclear.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: Do you know clearly every payment you have to make each month?

mau_duong_bay.nghia: {Chu_tu} makes exams, applications, procedures and dealings with more experienced people clearer.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Finish the paperwork still open around {chu_tu}, or ask someone more experienced for feedback.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: Which procedure or course of study have you been putting off for a while?

Mệnh.tieu_de: Studying and paperwork on your own go smoothly
Mệnh.nghia: Study, exams and applications you handle yourself are usually judged fairly; people with more experience readily guide you.
Mệnh.viec_nen_lam: Sign up for the course or exam you have been planning, and ask someone more experienced to look over your work.
Mệnh.cau_tu_soi: Which qualification or certificate have you meant to get for a long time?

Huynh Đệ.tieu_de: Siblings help with paperwork and studies
Huynh Đệ.nghia: Siblings and close friends often show you the way through procedures and studies, or help you talk with your parents.
Huynh Đệ.viec_nen_lam: For a tricky procedure, ask a sibling who has done it before rather than figuring it out alone.
Huynh Đệ.cau_tu_soi: When did a sibling last help you get through a piece of paperwork?

Phu Thê.tieu_de: Your partner helps with paperwork and both families
Phu Thê.nghia: Your partner often helps you sort out paperwork and studies, and is a gentle bridge with both sets of parents.
Phu Thê.viec_nen_lam: Let your partner read important documents with you, and ask them to talk with the parents when you find it hard.
Phu Thê.cau_tu_soi: Which paperwork are you handling alone that your partner would do better?

Tử Nữ.tieu_de: Your child's learning gets clear recognition
Tử Nữ.nghia: Your child's or students' learning, or what you make, is likely to be recognised through papers, qualifications or formal assessment.
Tử Nữ.viec_nen_lam: Keep your child's school records complete, or get certificates and registrations for what you make.
Tử Nữ.cau_tu_soi: What have you made that deserves a certificate?

Tài Bạch.nghia: Your money usually goes through clear contracts and records, so you rarely lose out over paperwork; money spent on learning is also well spent.
Tài Bạch.viec_nen_lam: For large sums, put it in black and white; set aside a fixed amount for learning.
Tài Bạch.cau_tu_soi: Which spending on learning are you still hesitating over?

Tật Ách.nghia: Regular check-ups with clear records suit you; when you need a professional, you usually find the right one.
Tật Ách.viec_nen_lam: Keep one folder of check-up records and book this year's check-up early.
Tật Ách.cau_tu_soi: When was your last regular check-up?

Thiên Di.tieu_de: You learn a lot away from home, and travel papers go smoothly
Thiên Di.nghia: Travelling or going abroad usually comes with smooth papers, visas and applications; you learn a lot when you are out.
Thiên Di.viec_nen_lam: Prepare papers for study or work abroad early; take short courses when you travel.
Thiên Di.cau_tu_soi: Where would you like to go to learn something new?

Nô Bộc.nghia: Friends and colleagues often introduce you to more experienced people or bosses, or show you how to handle procedures.
Nô Bộc.viec_nen_lam: When you need a guide, ask friends who has been through it and ask for an introduction.
Nô Bộc.cau_tu_soi: Which friend once introduced you to a teacher or mentor?

Quan Lộc.tieu_de: Work rises through qualifications and records
Quan Lộc.nghia: Your work is recognised through qualifications, certificates and clear reports; bosses easily see what you can do.
Quan Lộc.viec_nen_lam: Take a certificate that serves exactly the work you do, and send regular progress reports to your boss.
Quan Lộc.cau_tu_soi: Which certificate would help your current work the most?

Điền Trạch.nghia: Your home matters usually come with clear papers; parents and elders in the family readily help with the procedures.
Điền Trạch.viec_nen_lam: Check your title deed, lease and home papers, and ask the elders in the family when something is unclear.
Điền Trạch.cau_tu_soi: Which of your home papers is still out of date?

Phúc Đức.tieu_de: Reading and learning lighten your mind
Phúc Đức.nghia: Your inner life is fed by learning, reading and advice from people ahead of you; studying gives you peace.
Phúc Đức.viec_nen_lam: Keep an hour each week for reading or learning, and ask parents or former teachers when you are unsure.
Phúc Đức.cau_tu_soi: Which book or teacher once helped you through a confusing time?

mau_duong_bay.tieu_de: {A_tu} wears you out when you are away
mau_duong_bay.nghia: {Chu_tu} makes going out, travelling or entering new places weigh on your mind and drain more energy than usual.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: If {chu_tu} takes you far from home, have a backup plan and leave extra time.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: In an unfamiliar place, what do you usually need to feel steady?
mau_duong_bay.can_cu: Hua Ji in the Travel Palace faces the Life Palace directly (the opposite palace).

Mệnh.tieu_de: Out in the world you worry and tire yourself
Mệnh.nghia: Each time you go out or enter a new place, you put a lot of pressure on yourself; you often come home more tired than others.
Mệnh.viec_nen_lam: Before going somewhere new, write down three things you need to do there; once those three are done, that is enough.
Mệnh.cau_tu_soi: In an unfamiliar place, what tires you the most?

Huynh Đệ.tieu_de: Siblings pull you far from home
Huynh Đệ.nghia: Siblings and close friends often pull you into trips or tasks far away; looking after them out there drains you.
Huynh Đệ.viec_nen_lam: When siblings ask for help far away, ask about the time and money involved before saying yes.
Huynh Đệ.cau_tu_soi: Which recent trip did you take for family rather than for yourself?

Phu Thê.tieu_de: Your love life follows you out the door
Phu Thê.nghia: Your love life tends to follow you out: when you travel or go to work, your partner may worry and you may feel uneasy being apart.
Phu Thê.viec_nen_lam: When you have to be apart, agree on a time to call and keep to it.
Phu Thê.cau_tu_soi: When you are away from your partner, what makes you most uneasy?

Tử Nữ.tieu_de: Worrying about your child when they are away
Tử Nữ.nghia: Your children, students or own projects make you travel a lot, or you worry when your child goes out or studies far away.
Tử Nữ.viec_nen_lam: Agree with your child on how to stay in touch when they are out, then trust them to follow it.
Tử Nữ.cau_tu_soi: Do you worry because of your child, or because you yourself are not at ease?

Tài Bạch.tieu_de: Money keeps you on the move
Tài Bạch.nghia: Money matters make you run around a lot and travel is costly; spending away from home easily goes too far.
Tài Bạch.viec_nen_lam: Set a spending limit before each trip, and keep receipts to review.
Tài Bạch.cau_tu_soi: How much more than planned did your last trip cost?

Tật Ách.nghia: Long trips, moving house or time-zone changes tire you more than others; your energy suits a steady rhythm.
Tật Ách.viec_nen_lam: When you travel, bring familiar things, sleep well the first night, and do not schedule heavy tasks for the first day.
Tật Ách.cau_tu_soi: After a long trip, how many days do you need to get your rhythm back?

Nô Bộc.tieu_de: Friends and colleagues pull you out
Nô Bộc.nghia: Friends and colleagues often pull you into outings and get-togethers; fun, but it can cost energy and money.
Nô Bộc.viec_nen_lam: Choose which meetings really matter, and politely decline the ones that are only for fun.
Nô Bộc.cau_tu_soi: Which recent meet-up did you go to only because it was awkward to say no?

Quan Lộc.tieu_de: Work demands a lot of travel
Quan Lộc.nghia: Your work often requires travel, business trips or working in new places; changing work environments can make you tense.
Quan Lộc.viec_nen_lam: When you change workplaces or go on a business trip, give yourself a week to settle in before taking on more.
Quan Lộc.cau_tu_soi: In which work environment do you feel most steady?

Điền Trạch.tieu_de: Home matters pull you far away
Điền Trạch.nghia: Home matters often take you far away: moving house, looking after a family home elsewhere, or living away from home; moving tires you.
Điền Trạch.viec_nen_lam: If you are moving house or managing a home far away, make a task list and share it out among the family.
Điền Trạch.cau_tu_soi: Where do you truly feel at home?

Phúc Đức.tieu_de: Out and about, but your mind stays at home
Phúc Đức.nghia: When you go out you tend to carry your worries along and find it hard to enjoy new places; even on holiday you think about home.
Phúc Đức.viec_nen_lam: On a trip, put your phone away for one afternoon so your mind can really rest.
Phúc Đức.cau_tu_soi: Which trip do you remember as truly restful?

Phụ Mẫu.tieu_de: Paperwork and bosses keep you running around
Phụ Mẫu.nghia: Paperwork, procedures or tasks for parents and bosses often force you to travel and run errands outside.
Phụ Mẫu.viec_nen_lam: Group the paperwork that needs travel into one day, and prepare enough copies before you go.
Phụ Mẫu.cau_tu_soi: Which procedure has had you running back and forth the most?

mau_duong_bay.tieu_de: Earning money with your own hands
mau_duong_bay.nghia: Your own effort easily turns into income, especially the work you take the initiative on.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Note which work brings steady income so you can focus on it.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: Which work do you enjoy that also pays?

mau_duong_bay.tieu_de: Money tends to settle into savings
mau_duong_bay.nghia: The money you earn tends to turn into savings, a home or things that last.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Set clear savings goals and check on them regularly.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: What are you saving for?

mau_duong_bay.tieu_de: Worrying and carrying it all yourself
mau_duong_bay.nghia: You tend to put pressure on yourself, bear it alone, and find it hard to ask for help; the snag is usually in how you see yourself.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Pick one person you trust to tell what is worrying you, and allow yourself to do things imperfectly.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: When did you last ask someone for help?

mau_duong_bay.nghia: You are easily content and easily liked, but your enthusiasm also fades quickly.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Tie your good mood to a small goal so you keep the momentum.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: What did you start with great energy and then leave aside?

mau_duong_bay.nghia: Your income is fairly flexible but hard to hold on to without a plan.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Set up an automatic transfer of part of your income into savings as soon as it arrives.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: At the end of the month, do you know where your money went?

mau_duong_bay.tieu_de: Work that ties itself in knots
mau_duong_bay.nghia: You care a lot about work and tend to change direction yourself, or make things hard with standards that are too high.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Settle on one goal per quarter and ask colleagues for feedback.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: Which standard do you set for yourself that no one else asks of you?

mau_duong_bay.tieu_de: Work comes easily; keep the pace
mau_duong_bay.nghia: Job opportunities come to you fairly easily, but you can spread yourself thin if you take on too much.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Choose fewer tasks and see them through.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: Which task are you taking on only because it came easily?

mau_duong_bay.nghia: You tend to read into things and keep your feelings to yourself in love; snags usually come from what has not been said.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Say how you feel, starting with "I feel", instead of waiting for the other person to understand on their own.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: What do you hope your partner understands that you have never said?

mau_duong_bay.nghia: Your love life easily has natural joy, but it also needs tending so it does not fade.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Keep up small shared habits, regularly.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: Which small habit makes the two of you feel close?

mau_duong_bay.nghia: You tend to take on household chores and property matters, and change your mind easily about home plans.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Make a list of household tasks shared out among everyone, and keep a separate reserve for the home.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: Which household task are you carrying alone?

mau_duong_bay.nghia: The atmosphere at home is easily warm, but spending on the home also tends to grow.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Set a budget for repairs and purchases for the home.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: Did your recent spending on the home go to what the whole family really needs?

mau_duong_bay.tieu_de: A mind that struggles to rest
mau_duong_bay.nghia: You tend to overthink, blame yourself and find it hard to relax even in your free time.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Find an activity that truly rests your mind: walking, gardening, writing things down and leaving them there.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: What time of day does your mind feel calmest?

mau_duong_bay.nghia: You know how to find joy and have your own hobbies, but you may spend a lot on them.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Keep a separate budget for hobbies so you can enjoy them without worry.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: Which hobby truly feeds you, and which only passes the time?

mau_duong_bay.nghia: When you go out or are in a new environment, you tend to worry, hold back from showing yourself, or change plans halfway.
mau_duong_bay.viec_nen_lam: Prepare what you want to say and do before going out, and give yourself time to settle in.
mau_duong_bay.cau_tu_soi: What makes you hesitate when you walk into a new place?

tuan_triet_ghi_chu.y: Southern school: wherever Xun or Jie sits, it weakens or delays the effect of the stars and transformations in that palace, but does not erase it. A flight path into a palace with Xun or Jie should be read as present but slower or lighter, often needing a second attempt to complete.

thuan.mo_ta: The month shows favourable signs in this area: good for starting, expanding and meeting people.

binh.mo_ta: The month has no standout signs: good for working steadily on what you already have.

can_than.mo_ta: The month has a snag in this area: good for slowing down, preparing well and keeping a reserve.

ly_do.chong_ky: The month's Hua Ji (star {sao}) falls in the {cung}, on the same axis as the year's Hua Ji (in this very palace or the opposite one): this area may need more effort this month.
ly_do.song_loc: The month's Hua Lu (star {sao}) and the year's Hua Lu both fall in the {cung}: the door to good things in this area opens wider.
ly_do.loc_nhap_cung_chinh: The month's Hua Lu flies into the {cung} through the star {sao}: the area you are watching gets more opportunities.
ly_do.ky_xung_cung_chinh: The month's Hua Ji sits on the star {sao}, facing the {cung} from the opposite palace: things in this area need more careful preparation.
ly_do.ky_nhap_cung_chinh: The month's Hua Ji (star {sao}) falls straight into the {cung}: this area is where things are most likely to snag this month, so go slowly and clearly.
ly_do.khoa_giai: Hua Ke on the star {sao}, in the {cung}, helps loosen the snag: someone is likely to explain or help.

Mệnh.chu_de: This month you pay a lot of attention to yourself: your stamina, how you live, what you really want.
tu_soi: If you changed just one of your own habits this month, which would it be?
What would you like to promise yourself and keep until the end of the month?

thuan.ket_luan: A month when you get noticed and can step forward
thuan.viec: Step forward and do what you want
thuan.nen_lam: Set one small goal of your own and start on it in the first week. People listen to you more than usual.

binh.ket_luan: An even month, good for looking after yourself
binh.nen_lam: Sleep enough, eat on time, reorganise your weekly schedule. No big change is needed this month, just keep it steady.

can_than.ket_luan: A month to save your energy and take on less
can_than.viec: Take on less, save your energy
can_than.nen_lam: Say "let me think about it" before taking on more. Keep one free slot each week to rest.

Huynh Đệ.chu_de: This month siblings, close friends and peers you work alongside come up a lot.
tu_soi: When did you last check in on a sibling or a close friend?
Which person close to you would you like to thank but have not yet?

thuan.ket_luan: A good month to do things with siblings and close friends
thuan.nen_lam: Invite a sibling or close friend to do something small together: a shared trip, a side project. Their opinions are worth hearing this month.

binh.ket_luan: An even month, good for keeping in touch with loved ones
binh.viec: Check in and stay in touch
binh.nen_lam: Make a phone call or arrange a meal with a sibling or close friend. A small thing, but it keeps the bond.

can_than.ket_luan: A month to be clear with siblings and close friends
can_than.viec: Be clear about money with people close to you
can_than.nen_lam: If you lend money to or invest with siblings or close friends, write down the amount and the repayment date. Saying it plainly at the start saves hurt feelings later.

Phu Thê.chu_de: This month your love life, marriage or partner takes up a lot of your thoughts.
tu_soi: What do you want your partner to understand that you have not said?
When did the two of you last laugh together freely?

thuan.nen_lam: Set aside an evening just for the two of you, or speak up if you have your eye on someone. Words are well received this month.

binh.ket_luan: An even month, good for tending the relationship
binh.nen_lam: Check in every day, share the housework, remember the dates that matter to you both. No big decisions needed yet.

can_than.ket_luan: A month to speak slowly and listen more in love
can_than.nen_lam: When you disagree, leave it until the next day before talking again. Big steps like marriage or moving in together deserve a more careful discussion.

Tử Nữ.chu_de: This month you focus on your children, your students or something you made with your own hands.
tu_soi: What are you making that you would like others to see this month?
What does a child or younger person near you need to hear from you?

thuan.ket_luan: A happy month for children and what you create
thuan.viec: Make time for your children and your creative work
thuan.nen_lam: Take your children out, find a course that suits them, or carry on with the piece, writing or product you have been nurturing.

binh.ket_luan: An even month, good for guiding children and continuing unfinished work
binh.viec: Guide steadily, keep going with unfinished work
binh.nen_lam: Spend a little time each day listening to your child, or carry on with your own handiwork bit by bit.

can_than.ket_luan: A month that needs patience with your children and your work
can_than.viec: Be more patient with your children and your work
can_than.nen_lam: Scold less and ask why first. If what you are making is not right yet, fix it part by part; do not abandon it.

Tài Bạch.chu_de: This month you pay more attention than usual to money coming in and going out.
tu_soi: Which expense this month could you drop without regret?
If a small extra sum came in, where would you put it first?

thuan.viec: Find extra income, collect what you are owed
thuan.nen_lam: Propose a price rise, take on extra work, remind people who still owe you. When money comes in, set part of it aside that same day.

binh.ket_luan: An even month, good for sorting out your spending
binh.nen_lam: Record your spending this month and cut one thing you do not need. No need to put money into anything new yet.

can_than.ket_luan: A month to keep a tight hold on money
can_than.nen_lam: Big purchases, lending or new investments should wait a few more weeks. Read contracts carefully and keep a reserve. This is not investment advice.

Tật Ách.chu_de: This month your body and daily rhythm deserve more of your attention.
tu_soi: What is your body reminding you of that you keep ignoring?
At what time of day do you feel strongest, and what are you using it for?

thuan.ket_luan: A good month to start a healthy habit
thuan.nen_lam: Take up a gentle form of exercise, book a regular check-up, make your meals a bit healthier. What you start this month is easy to keep.

binh.ket_luan: An even month, good for keeping regular meal and sleep times
binh.viec: Keep regular meal and sleep times
binh.nen_lam: Go to bed before 11 pm, walk every day, drink enough water. A steady rhythm matters more than hard workouts.

can_than.ket_luan: A month to rest on time and not overdo it
can_than.viec: Rest on time, do not push too hard
can_than.nen_lam: Stay up late less and take on fewer rush jobs. If tiredness lasts, see a doctor; their advice is what counts, this reading is not a substitute for a doctor.

Thiên Di.chu_de: This month going out, travelling, meeting strangers or working somewhere new comes to the fore.
tu_soi: Which place or person out there would you like to see more of this month?
When did you last try something somewhere completely new?

thuan.ket_luan: A month for going out and widening your circle
thuan.viec: Go out and widen your circle
thuan.nen_lam: Meet partners, go to events, take on work somewhere new. Strangers are likely to bring good news this month.

binh.ket_luan: An even month, with a moderate amount of travel
binh.viec: Travel in moderation, keep existing ties
binh.nen_lam: Plan ahead wherever you go, and stay in touch with people you know elsewhere. No need to change jobs or move house yet.

can_than.ket_luan: A month when travel and new people need careful preparation
can_than.nen_lam: Check your papers, schedule and the weather before you go. Business offers from people you have just met deserve a closer look.

Nô Bộc.chu_de: This month friends, colleagues and the people you work with come up a lot.
tu_soi: Who around you needs a thank-you or a little help?
Which person on your team would you like to understand a bit better?

thuan.ket_luan: A month when friends and colleagues help each other easily
thuan.viec: Ask friends and colleagues for support
thuan.nen_lam: Do not be shy to ask for help, invite people to work together, introduce people to each other. Connections made this month are likely to be useful.

binh.ket_luan: An even month, good for keeping up the ties around you
binh.nen_lam: Thank the people who helped you, reply to messages you left hanging. No need to widen your circle yet.

can_than.ket_luan: A month to be clear when working together
can_than.nen_lam: Write down who does what and by when. Think twice before guaranteeing a loan or lending things or money this month.

Quan Lộc.chu_de: This month work, your role and your results are what you care about most.
tu_soi: Which work task, if finished this month, would take the most weight off you?
Which skill would you like to improve so work gets easier?

thuan.viec: Propose ideas, take on new work
thuan.nen_lam: Present your ideas, ask for more responsibility, apply for a new position. The effort you put in this month is likely to be noticed.

binh.ket_luan: An even month, good for consolidating the work you have
binh.nen_lam: Finish outstanding tasks, rework your methods, learn one small new skill. No need to switch jobs yet.

can_than.ket_luan: A month to work slowly and surely
can_than.nen_lam: Double-check figures and documents before sending them. If you want to change jobs, prepare well; do not decide while you are annoyed.

Điền Trạch.chu_de: This month your home, where you live and the mood in the family come up often.
tu_soi: Which corner of your home, if tidied, would make you feel better?
Which recent family meal was the happiest, and why?

thuan.ket_luan: A good month for home and housing
thuan.viec: Take care of the home, fix up your space
thuan.nen_lam: Repair what is broken, buy what you need, view homes if you are planning to buy or rent. Home tasks go smoothly this month.

binh.ket_luan: An even month, good for tidying up and keeping house routines
binh.viec: Tidy up, keep the household routine
binh.nen_lam: Tidy one corner of the house and have dinner with your family. No hurry to buy or sell property.

can_than.ket_luan: A month to look carefully at property matters
can_than.nen_lam: If you are buying, selling or renting, read the contract carefully and ask someone who knows. If there is disagreement at home, speak gently and take it slowly.

Phúc Đức.chu_de: This month you need more peace: rest, your own hobbies, visiting grandparents and relatives.
tu_soi: What made you feel lightest in the past week?
Which hobby have you not made time for in a long while?

thuan.ket_luan: A light-hearted month, good for doing what you love
thuan.nen_lam: Make time for your hobbies, visit a temple, see relatives, do a small good deed. A good mood helps other things go well.

binh.ket_luan: An even month, good for making time to rest
binh.viec: Keep time for yourself to rest
binh.nen_lam: One phone-free evening a week, reading or walking. Resting well is also something that needs doing.

can_than.ket_luan: A month to worry less and look after your mood
can_than.viec: Do not let worries drag on
can_than.nen_lam: Write down what is worrying you and tell someone you trust. If you often sleep lightly, cut back on evening tasks.

Phụ Mẫu.chu_de: This month parents, elders, bosses or paperwork and studies come up.
tu_soi: The last time you asked your parents or someone older for advice, what was it about?
Which paperwork have you kept promising to finish but still have not?

thuan.ket_luan: A month when elders and bosses readily support you
thuan.viec: Ask for advice from those ahead of you, handle paperwork
thuan.nen_lam: Meet your boss to present your case, submit applications, sit exams, apply for permits. Elders are likely to lend a hand this month.

binh.ket_luan: An even month, good for visiting parents and sorting papers
binh.viec: Visit your parents, sort your papers
binh.nen_lam: Call home, organise your files, renew documents that are about to expire.

can_than.ket_luan: A month to be careful with paperwork and with what you say to those above you
can_than.viec: Be careful with papers and with what you say to those above you
can_than.nen_lam: Read carefully before you sign and keep copies. If you disagree with parents or bosses, wait for a calm moment to talk.

Mệnh.tieu_de: You feel more confident and get noticed
Mệnh.noi_dung: Others notice you more easily and your words carry more weight. Good for introducing yourself and taking on a new role.

Huynh Đệ.tieu_de: Siblings and close friends are a good support
Huynh Đệ.noi_dung: People close to you readily help, share opportunities or join forces with you.

Phu Thê.noi_dung: The two of you understand each other better; if you are single, you meet someone on your wavelength more easily. Your partner may also bring an opportunity.

Tử Nữ.tieu_de: Joy from your children and what you make
Tử Nữ.noi_dung: Your children or students are likely to have good news; what you make with your own hands is well received.

Tài Bạch.tieu_de: Money comes in more easily than usual
Tài Bạch.noi_dung: There may be extra income, payments arriving on time, or a way to earn more.

Tật Ách.tieu_de: Your energy comes back more easily
Tật Ách.noi_dung: Your body recovers more easily after tiring days, a good time to start healthy habits; your mood is lighter.

Thiên Di.noi_dung: Travel, meeting new people and working elsewhere easily open doors. Strangers tend to warm to you.

Nô Bộc.tieu_de: Friends and colleagues are happy to help
Nô Bộc.noi_dung: People around you are willing to help; teamwork flows more smoothly than usual.

Quan Lộc.noi_dung: What you are working on is likely to show results, get recognised or bring a new offer.

Điền Trạch.noi_dung: Shopping for the home, repairs and finding a new place go smoothly; home feels happier.

Phúc Đức.tieu_de: A light heart and a good mood
Phúc Đức.noi_dung: You find peace easily and enjoy small things; your own hobbies bring joy.

Phụ Mẫu.noi_dung: Parents, bosses and teachers readily help; paperwork and exams go through easily.

Mệnh.tieu_de: Prone to taking everything on and overthinking
Mệnh.noi_dung: You may blame yourself, take everything on and feel worn out.
Mệnh.huong_xu_ly: Share the work out, say no to what is not needed, get enough sleep.

Huynh Đệ.tieu_de: Possible friction with siblings and close friends
Huynh Đệ.noi_dung: Money matters or sharp words with people close to you may weigh on your mind.
Huynh Đệ.huong_xu_ly: Be clear from the start, and write down any money you put in or lend.

Phu Thê.tieu_de: Easy misunderstandings between the two of you
Phu Thê.noi_dung: A careless remark can turn into something big; you may read too much into your partner's reactions.
Phu Thê.huong_xu_ly: Ask again to be sure before getting upset, and pick a time when you are both calm to talk.

Tử Nữ.tieu_de: Your children or your work cause worry
Tử Nữ.noi_dung: Your children, students or what you are making need more effort than expected.
Tử Nữ.huong_xu_ly: Break the work down, be patient step by step, and ask for extra help.

Tài Bạch.tieu_de: Money goes out faster than it comes in
Tài Bạch.noi_dung: There may be an unexpected expense or money arriving later than promised.
Tài Bạch.huong_xu_ly: Keep a reserve, put off big purchases, and write down every loan. This is not investment advice.

Tật Ách.tieu_de: Easily tired if you overdo it
Tật Ách.noi_dung: Your body tells you it is tired when you stay up late or eat irregularly.
Tật Ách.huong_xu_ly: Sleep early, eat on time, and see a doctor if tiredness lasts; this reading is not a substitute for a doctor.

Thiên Di.tieu_de: Travel and outside matters may hit snags
Thiên Di.noi_dung: Schedules may slip and misunderstandings with strangers come easily.
Thiên Di.huong_xu_ly: Leave earlier than planned, check your papers, get to know new acquaintances properly.

Nô Bộc.tieu_de: Shared work may go off track
Nô Bộc.noi_dung: Friends or colleagues may annoy you or fail to keep their word.
Nô Bộc.huong_xu_ly: Write down each person's share of the work, and avoid guaranteeing or lending.

Quan Lộc.tieu_de: Work under a lot of pressure
Quan Lộc.noi_dung: Tasks may pile up, small mistakes slip in, or results come late.
Quan Lộc.huong_xu_ly: Do one task at a time, check carefully before sending, and say early if you will miss a deadline.

Điền Trạch.noi_dung: Broken things, home costs or family matters keep you busy.
Điền Trạch.huong_xu_ly: Fix small breakages right away, read property papers carefully, and talk gently with your family.

Phúc Đức.tieu_de: Prone to worry and hard to relax
Phúc Đức.noi_dung: You may overthink, sleep lightly and find it hard to enjoy small things.
Phúc Đức.huong_xu_ly: Write down what worries you, make time for hobbies, and talk with someone you trust.

Phụ Mẫu.tieu_de: Paperwork and those above you may snag
Phụ Mẫu.noi_dung: Paperwork may have gaps; you and your parents or boss may see things differently.
Phụ Mẫu.huong_xu_ly: Read carefully before signing, keep copies, and choose a calm moment to talk.

bo_sung.song_loc: This area is already going well this year, and this month adds another layer.
bo_sung.loc_vao_thang: The good news lands right on the month's main theme, so it is easy to see.
bo_sung.chong_ky: This area already needs attention this year, and this month adds another layer.
bo_sung.ky_vao_thang: This is also the month's main theme, so the pressure is easier to feel.
bo_sung.khoa_giai: Someone who understands the situation is willing to help if you ask.
bo_sung.loc_ky_cung: The good part and the worry come from the same place: what you gain also brings more to look after.
